Our focus areas

SHMT brings together healthcare services, training, and community support to serve people with dignity.

01

Maternal & newborn care

Antenatal consultations, safe childbirth support, neonatal care, and ongoing maternal monitoring.

02

Women’s preventive health

Accessible VIA screening, health counseling, infection management, and follow-up support.

03

Midwifery education

Professional education, practical clinical experience, mentorship, and scholarships.

04

Diagnostics & laboratory

Pathology investigations, ultrasound imaging, pregnancy evaluations, and preventive screening.

Our story

A life dedicated to the service of humanity

Sahera Hasan Memorial Trust was established in 2001 to carry forward a family commitment to serving ordinary people. The Trust supports accessible healthcare and community wellbeing through Sahera–Hasan Memorial Hospital and its related initiatives.

Care guided by dignity, compassion, and a commitment to community.
